historical_record.description: The site held a fenced private parking lot for approximately 13 cars and a 780-square-foot warehouse.
The City Planning Commission upheld the Preliminary Negative Declaration for a five-story structure with nine residential units and approximately 800 square feet of ground-floor commercial space.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use to demolish an existing storage structure and construct a five-story building with ground-level commercial space, 9 units of housing, and 9 parking spaces in a ground-level garage.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the change of use of the property from parking and storage to residential and retail uses, as proposed.
